items.pump: A single concrete pump truck: a white cab at the front, a long truck chassis with many black tyres, and on top a big orange concrete boom made of three long straight flat sections folded back on themselves in a neat flat zig-zag stack lying horizontally along the whole length of the truck, a grey concrete pipe running along the boom, a grey concrete hopper at the very back, folded outrigger legs
items.piledriver: A single crawler pile driving rig: a yellow body with a cab on dark grey caterpillar tracks, a very tall straight vertical steel leader mast standing upright at the front, a heavy grey hammer block hanging high on the mast above a long grey steel pile
items.crane: A single yellow mobile truck crane: a long truck with many black tyres, a small cab, and a long thick telescopic crane boom lying almost flat along the top of the truck pointing forward, a hook hanging at the tip
items.boomlift: A single orange articulated boom lift aerial work platform on four big black tyres, the boom folded down low over the base, a small platform basket at the front with a worker in a yellow hard hat standing in it
items.skidsteer: A single small yellow skid steer loader with a big front bucket lowered to the ground, a cage cab with a worker in a hard hat, four black tyres
